title: The fixed scalar complex comparison is the derived counit
statement: For every internal complex, the fixed coefficient scalar comparison equals the total left derived scalar functor counit at its image in the homotopy category.

source.place: Tag 07A4, scalar localization comparison and the derived-counit factorization.

proof.text: Expand coefficientInternalScalarComplex. Apply the existing counit factorization equation for the exact derived functor comparison. The complex-homotopy localization comparison has identity components; map identities and cancel the resulting identity factors.

from.place: identify the complex scalar comparison with the derived counit

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientScalarTensor_complexCounit (Z : Scheme.{u})
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules R Z) ℤ) :
    coefficientInternalScalarComplex a Z K =
      (Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap a Z)).leftDerivedFunctorCounit.app
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj K)
